plugins.name: task
plugins.description: Markdown task management: task files with a built-in workflow table, epics, tags and ID allocation that is safe across parallel sessions. Pure bash + awk.

plugins.name: session-storage
plugins.description: Session-scoped key-value storage for Claude Code with automatic cleanup. Pure bash, no dependencies.

plugins.name: docs-manager
plugins.description: Docs as a product: auto-generated _index.md navigation, link and anchor checks, text-source diagrams with staleness tracking, and a catalogue of external reference docs.

plugins.name: task-roadmap
plugins.description: Abstract-Gantt roadmap for a markdown task set: scheduled by dependencies and estimates, critical path highlighted, regenerated as tasks change.

plugins.name: delay
plugins.description: Queue slow jobs like autotest suites for your Mac's run window: it wakes, runs them in the project's docker container, and keeps the results for the next session.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Run several Claude Code sessions on one working tree and branch without lost edits: coordinator/worker playbook, task ownership, hand-offs, file holds, a slot queue and guard hooks.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: Kick off a new or existing project with a branching questionnaire, then turn the answers into a charter, a quality level with its checks, and the project's CLAUDE.md.
